body.x: With the 17th COEX FOOD WEEK coming to a successful close last November, the Seoul Food Tech Startup Center announced the achievement of 15 companies in the center that attended the expo.

According to the Seoul Food Tech Startup Center, these companies had the accomplishments of accruing a total of 21,000 visitors in the expo, selling 10 million KRW worth of products, and having 146 consultations with buyers. They also emphasized the fact that a total of 6 companies won awards in the competitions that were held as side events to prove the superior caliber of companies in the center.
Seoul Food Tech Startup Center at FOODWEEK 2022 | Filming and Editing - Aving News

Companies from the Seoul Food Tech Startup Center that participated were made up of △WELLFISH (dried fish home meals) △Fine Food Lab (plant-based milk, vegetable smoothies) △Comoats (phytochemical-based drinks and F&B) △Romansive (stress, depression, insomnia relieving and sleep inducing drink) △Fromchild (plant-based protein foods) △CHUNKI Project (home baking content) △ SUNNYDAY (kimchi seasoning block kit) △Tomin (sparkling fruit juice drink) △Punta Company (online tasting commerce platform ‘Sikhoogyung’) △Wemeet (plant-based meat-substitute chicken) △Vurtle (Veginer Sauce) △Sweetdo (home baking kit) △Readybloom (high-protein, low-sugar granola) △ SallyCook (smart freeze dried nutritious foods).

3 companies from the center (Romansive, Fine Food Lab, Comoats) were included in the Innovative Food Startup Awards that were selected by media and YouTube channels from Singapore, Vietnam, and the US, in addition to AVING News, the global media channel that conducted interviews on site.

The Seoul Food Tech Startup Center’s Punta Company won the top award at the ‘Food Tech IR Demo Day’ that was held on the 2nd day of the expo and had the honor of attending the world’s biggest IT and appliance expo in CES 2023 and receiving funds for training. At the event, which was held as a part of expanding the business and investments of Korean food tech startups, Punta Company had the excellent business value and development potential of their online tasting commerce platform, ‘Sikhoogyung’, recognized.

body.x: Meanwhile, Food Tech is becoming a new area by combining advanced technologies amid growing importance of food due to climate change, energy, and war. Amid this trend, the "Seoul Food Startup Center" was established by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to support food processing technology, licensing, patents, design and promotional marketing so that agricultural products can be reborn as high value-added products.

It helps agri-food-related companies develop innovative ideas and new products, and there is a networking space between open kitchen and tenant companies that can produce office space (open, individual) and prototypes. It also supports various start-up support services such as ▲ start-up education ▲ mentoring ▲ consulting ▲ investment linkage, and conducts consulting and mentoring, and various food-related programs involving citizens for the growth of tenant companies and the development of the sixth industry in the agri-food sector.
